selection.severalAvailable: restore available saved choice, otherwise require a choice
selection.noneAvailable: disable launch and show detection state
selection.legacyRequestWithoutProvider: resolve only when one launch adapter is available
selection.retry: reconcile the original request and pinned provider before any new selection
selection.fallback: never switch a queued mission to another provider

detection.method: read-only PATH and bounded per-user installation entrypoints
detection.unsupportedInstalled: show installed with adapter-needed reason; unavailable for mission launch

invariants: Launch commands are trusted server-side argument arrays with shell disabled, never browser-supplied commands
Provider identity is pinned to a mission, persisted, included in idempotency and preserved in office employees

A definitive pre-queue rejection returns accepted=false; an unknown outcome stays pinned through unmarked authentication rejections, malformed responses and mismatched acknowledgements until the original request id is reconciled or explicitly rejected
Executable availability means installed, not authenticated or guaranteed account access
Access is enforced by each provider adapter; no blanket permission bypass or silent access upgrade
Raw tool input/output, reasoning, stderr, credentials and executable paths do not enter public snapshots or persisted history
CLI startup, authentication, protocol, permission and nonzero-exit failures cannot become successful completion
Existing cancellation, descendant ownership, timeouts, bounded streams and private file-change reads remain enforced
Existing Codex-only history is migrated as Codex; unknown provider history is not relabeled as Codex
